title: fix: keep the dictation border visible in new sessions
body:
Related: #200758

## What Problem This Solves

Starting dictation in New Session no longer shows its animated border after the image-drop highlight correction in #200758. The two visual effects accidentally shared the same paint surface.

## User Impact

User impact: dictation keeps its visible recording border, while image drags still tint the message box rather than the context tray. No migration, permission change, or user action is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Give the drop tint its own unused pseudo-element and leave dictation's existing border untouched. No state, event handlers, or attachment admission changes. This follows the substantive ClawSweeper finding discovered during the original landing closeout.

Implemented for @Patrick-Erichsen as part of the original scoped composer fix.

## Work sessions

Linked for team reference; these sessions aren’t public.

- [Original discussion with @Patrick-Erichsen](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/~key/dashboard/06c8af87-d792-4850-b9b1-d52322e6cc5a)
- [Implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/~key/subagent/465d94ab-4b60-48ae-9df2-e7f752739cda)

## Evidence

- The production-bundled browser regression clicks Dictate and receives synthetic transcription. It failed before the repair: the border had opacity 0, inset 0, and z-index 1 instead of dictation's visible border. It passes after moving the tint.
- All 16 tests across browser dictation status and file-drop guard passed (31.68 seconds), covering dictation start/stop/cancel, draft retention, the restored border, drop-tint geometry, nested drag depth, tray attachments, and chat stray-drop guards.
- UI and UI-E2E TypeScript, scoped oxlint/stylelint/format, and git diff whitespace checks passed.
- Exact-head [CI run 44160612479, attempt 1](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/44160612479) passed: 21 selected jobs succeeded, 30 were out-of-scope/skipped, no failed or unfinished jobs. The required CI/security gate passed; this follow-up used ordinary protected squash landing without a CI exception.
- Independent Codex autoreview of the complete delta against 1f3524eec31abbfef396d69cc22758e510fdc4ee, P0–P2: scoped-clean, no actionable findings. Local ClawSweeper remains unavailable due to its existing dirty checkout; use the documented fallback and initial automatic hosted review.
- Simplification: only two overlay selectors plus an ownership comment change in production; no new handlers or runtime state. The new regression uses the existing Dictate fixture.
- Inspected clean and annotated before/after frames show the real production UI at 1056×740, dark theme, through the actual Dictate control with fake browser audio and synthetic Gateway transcription. Live speech recognition, native OS drag initiation, and live model execution are not covered.

[Clean and annotated before/after comparison](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/200770#issuecomment-6958817872). The inspected clean Before and After screenshots were also delivered as attachments in the originating chat.
